title: 氧化溝污水處理~Oxidation-ditch wastewater treatment
focus: 環狀流場、污泥齡與氧需求的協調~Coordinating loop flow, sludge age and oxygen demand
summary: 本課以環狀流場、污泥齡與氧需求的協調為主線，從入口負荷盤點、有效環槽容積、固體庫存與活性、食微比與負荷變動進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。~This course develops coordinating loop flow, sludge age and oxygen demand through ten connected units, beginning with influent loading, effective loop volume, solids inventory and activity, food-to-microorganism ratio. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

units.title: 入口負荷盤點~Influent loading
units.mechanism: 先分離水量尖峰與有機物尖峰，才能判定環槽需要調蓄還是反應容量。~Separate hydraulic peaks from organic peaks before choosing equalization or reaction capacity.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=2000 m³/d；C=180 mg/L。模型 L=QC/1000，代入得到 360 kg/d。適用邊界：穩定流量與流量加權濃度；瞬時樣本不代表整日。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=2000 m³/d; C=180 mg/L. Model L=QC/1000 gives 360 kg/d. Applicability: Steady flow and flow-weighted concentration; a grab sample does not represent a day.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「入口負荷盤點」的觀測點。比對累積流量計與流量比例混合樣本。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for influent loading. Compare the totalizing flowmeter with a flow-proportional composite sample. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 單次低濃度樣本可能漏掉夜間排放。診斷與介入：先回查濃度基準與流量加權採樣，再重算負荷。~A low grab sample can miss nighttime discharge. Diagnostic response: First check the concentration basis and flow-weighted sampling, then recalculate loading.
units.misconception: 濃度降低必定表示日負荷降低。~Lower concentration always means lower daily load.
units.practice: 只改變 C:180→210 mg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 360 變為 420 kg/d。用「入口負荷盤點」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only C:180→210 mg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 360 to 420 kg/d. Explain the direction using influent loading, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 有效環槽容積~Effective loop volume
units.mechanism: 環槽循環改善混合，但短流與沉積會縮小有效反應空間。~Loop circulation promotes mixing, while short-circuiting and deposits reduce effective reaction volume.
units.model: 原創教學假設：V=1500 m³；Q=3000 m³/d。模型 θ=24V/Q，代入得到 12 h。適用邊界：名義水力停留時間；不包含短流、死角及回流的停留時間分布。~Original teaching assumptions: V=1500 m³; Q=3000 m³/d. Model θ=24V/Q gives 12 h. Applicability: Nominal hydraulic residence time; it does not resolve short-circuiting, dead zones or recirculation residence-time distributions.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「有效環槽容積」的觀測點。以槽有效容積與示蹤劑穿透曲線交叉檢查。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for effective loop volume. Cross-check effective volume with a tracer breakthrough curve. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 以土建總容積替代有效水體會高估時間。診斷與介入：用示蹤曲線及有效容積修正假設，先在模擬中比較分流方案。~Using gross civil volume overestimates residence. Diagnostic response: Revise assumptions using tracing/effective volume and compare flow-distribution options in simulation first.
units.misconception: 水在溝內循環一次即處理完成。~One circuit completes treatment.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:3000→3600 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 12 變為 10 h。用「有效環槽容積」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:3000→3600 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 12 to 10 h. Explain the direction using effective loop volume, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 固體庫存與活性~Solids inventory and activity
units.mechanism: MLSS 包含無機物及非活性固體，必須搭配 MLVSS 與比活性判讀。~MLSS includes inorganic and inactive solids; interpret it with MLVSS and specific activity.
units.model: 原創教學假設：V=1500 m³；X=3 kg/m³。模型 MX=VX，代入得到 4500 kg solids。適用邊界：X 必須指明 MLSS 或 MLVSS；不能把懸浮固體全部當活性菌。~Original teaching assumptions: V=1500 m³; X=3 kg/m³. Model MX=VX gives 4500 kg solids. Applicability: State whether X is MLSS or MLVSS; suspended solids are not all active biomass.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「固體庫存與活性」的觀測點。比較混合均勻後多深度的 MLSS、MLVSS 樣本。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for solids inventory and activity. Compare well-mixed MLSS and MLVSS samples at several depths. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 砂粒積累使 MLSS 升高卻沒有增加反應能力。診斷與介入：以多位置固體樣本核對庫存，將死區分開建模。~Accumulated grit raises MLSS without adding reaction capacity. Diagnostic response: Check inventory with multi-location solids samples and model dead zones separately.
units.misconception: MLSS 越高代表活菌越多。~Higher MLSS always means more live organisms.
units.practice: 只改變 X:3→3.5 kg/m³，其餘假設固定；結果應由 4500 變為 5250 kg solids。用「固體庫存與活性」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only X:3→3.5 kg/m³, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 4500 to 5250 kg solids. Explain the direction using solids inventory and activity, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 食微比與負荷變動~Food-to-microorganism ratio
units.mechanism: 把可降解負荷對照生物量，而非只依池容調整進流。~Compare biodegradable load with biomass rather than sizing intake by volume alone.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=2000 m³/d；S=0.18 kg BOD/m³；V=1500 m³；Xv=2.4 kg MLVSS/m³。模型 F/M=QS/(VXv)，代入得到 0.1 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d)。適用邊界：單一進流的平均負荷；需另看可生物降解比例與回流負荷。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=2000 m³/d; S=0.18 kg BOD/m³; V=1500 m³; Xv=2.4 kg MLVSS/m³. Model F/M=QS/(VXv) gives 0.1 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d). Applicability: Average single-inlet loading; biodegradability and recycle loads require separate assessment.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「食微比與負荷變動」的觀測點。核對 BOD 樣本、MLVSS 與生物槽有效體積。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for food-to-microorganism ratio. Check BOD samples, MLVSS and effective biological volume. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只看總 COD 會高估微生物可利用的食物。診斷與介入：核對可利用有機物與揮發固體基準，再比較負荷配置。~Total COD can overstate usable substrate. Diagnostic response: Check bioavailable organics and volatile-solids bases before comparing load allocation.
units.misconception: 池容不變就能承受任意濃度。~Fixed volume accommodates any concentration.
units.practice: 只改變 S:0.18→0.24 kg/m³，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.1 變為 0.13333333 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d)。用「食微比與負荷變動」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only S:0.18→0.24 kg/m³, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.1 to 0.13333333 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d). Explain the direction using food-to-microorganism ratio, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 排泥與污泥齡~Wasting and sludge age
units.mechanism: 排泥控制菌體在系統中的平均停留，回流則重新分配庫存。~Wasting controls average biomass residence; recycle redistributes the inventory.
units.model: 原創教學假設：固體庫存 MX=4500 kg；排泥=180 kg/d；出流水固體=20 kg/d。模型 SRT=MX/(W+E)，代入得到 22.5 d。適用邊界：全系統固體收支的準穩態估計；回流不是離開系統的排泥。~Original teaching assumptions: Solids inventory MX=4500 kg; wasting=180 kg/d; effluent solids=20 kg/d. Model SRT=MX/(W+E) gives 22.5 d. Applicability: Quasi-steady whole-system solids balance; return sludge is not a solids exit.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「排泥與污泥齡」的觀測點。從排泥流量、含固率與出流水 TSS 各算質量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for wasting and sludge age. Calculate masses independently from wasting flow, solids fraction and effluent TSS. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 把回流量算成排泥會得到錯誤污泥齡。診斷與介入：用實際排出乾固體修正 SRT，分開回流與離開系統的流股。~Counting recycle as wasting gives a false SRT. Diagnostic response: Correct SRT with actual exported dry solids, separating recycle from system exits.
units.misconception: 加大回流必定直接增加污泥齡。~Increasing recycle directly raises SRT.
units.practice: 只改變 W:180→230 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 22.5 變為 18 d。用「排泥與污泥齡」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only W:180→230 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 22.5 to 18 d. Explain the direction using wasting and sludge age, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 曝氣與溶氧梯度~Aeration and DO gradients
units.mechanism: 循環沿程的耗氧與補氧共同形成好氧、低氧區，單點 DO 不能代表全槽。~Oxygen use and supply create aerobic and low-oxygen zones along the loop; one DO point is insufficient.
units.model: 原創教學假設：kLa=4 h⁻¹；C*=8 mg/L；C=2 mg/L；V=1000 m³。模型 OTR=kLa(C*-C)V/1000，代入得到 24 kg O2/h。適用邊界：等溫、均勻混合的簡化傳質；kLa 已假設為污水條件。~Original teaching assumptions: kLa=4 h⁻¹; C*=8 mg/L; C=2 mg/L; V=1000 m³. Model OTR=kLa(C*-C)V/1000 gives 24 kg O2/h. Applicability: Isothermal mixed-tank transfer; kLa is assumed to represent wastewater conditions.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「曝氣與溶氧梯度」的觀測點。比對溶氧剖面、耗氧率與尾氣推估。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for aeration and do gradients. Compare DO profiles, oxygen-uptake rate and off-gas estimates. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 探頭靠近曝氣器會掩蓋遠端缺氧。診斷與介入：比對不同位置 DO 與耗氧率，區分需求改變和傳氧退化。~A probe beside an aerator masks remote oxygen depletion. Diagnostic response: Compare spatial DO and oxygen uptake to separate demand changes from transfer deterioration.
units.misconception: 所有位置 DO 必須完全相同。~DO must be identical everywhere.
units.practice: 只改變 C:2→3 mg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 24 變為 20 kg O2/h。用「曝氣與溶氧梯度」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only C:2→3 mg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 24 to 20 kg O2/h. Explain the direction using aeration and do gradients, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 缺氧段碳源分配~Carbon allocation in anoxic zones
units.mechanism: 反硝化需要可利用電子供體；把碳先在好氧區耗掉會限制後段脫氮。~Denitrification needs available electron donors; upstream aerobic carbon consumption can limit nitrogen removal.
units.model: 原創教學假設：NO3-N 去除量=30 kg/d；電子當量=2.86 kg COD/kg N。模型 CODmin=2.86×N，代入得到 85.8 kg COD/d。適用邊界：僅硝酸鹽還原的理論電子當量；不含菌體合成、溶氧與其他耗碳。~Original teaching assumptions: NO3-N removed=30 kg/d; electron equivalent=2.86 kg COD/kg N. Model CODmin=2.86×N gives 85.8 kg COD/d. Applicability: Theoretical nitrate electron equivalent only; biomass synthesis, DO and other carbon demand are omitted.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「缺氧段碳源分配」的觀測點。獨立量測 NO3-N、NO2-N、可利用 COD，避免把總 COD 全算可用。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for carbon allocation in anoxic zones. Measure NO3-N, NO2-N and available COD separately rather than treating all COD as usable. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 剩餘硝酸鹽可能來自缺碳而非缺少池容。診斷與介入：查可利用碳與攜入氧，先核對電子供體收支。~Residual nitrate may reflect carbon shortage rather than insufficient volume. Diagnostic response: Check available carbon and oxygen carryover, then close the donor balance.
units.misconception: 反硝化需要持續大量供氧。~Denitrification needs continuous high oxygen supply.
units.practice: 只改變 N:30→36 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 85.8 變為 102.96 kg COD/d。用「缺氧段碳源分配」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only N:30→36 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 85.8 to 102.96 kg COD/d. Explain the direction using carbon allocation in anoxic zones, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 沉澱池水力界面~Clarifier hydraulic interface
units.mechanism: 環槽的良好反應仍需沉澱池將固體分離，尖峰流量可能控制全廠表現。~Good biological reaction still requires separation; peak clarifier flow can control plant performance.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=3000 m³/d；A=120 m²。模型 SOR=Q/A，代入得到 25 m/d。適用邊界：表面溢流率只是一個水力指標，不能單獨決定絮凝沉降效率。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=3000 m³/d; A=120 m². Model SOR=Q/A gives 25 m/d. Applicability: Surface overflow rate is a hydraulic metric, not a complete predictor of flocculent settling.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「沉澱池水力界面」的觀測點。將流量、池面積與沉降柱結果一起比較。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for clarifier hydraulic interface. Compare flow and plan area with settling-column observations. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 提高進流卻只觀察環槽會漏掉固體流失。診斷與介入：比較分池流量及沉降測試，先評估配流是否失衡。~Increasing flow while observing only the ditch misses solids escape. Diagnostic response: Compare cell flows and settling tests, first checking distribution imbalance.
units.misconception: 反應完成後沉澱池大小無關緊要。~Clarifier size is irrelevant after reaction.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:3000→4200 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 25 變為 35 m/d。用「沉澱池水力界面」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:3000→4200 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 25 to 35 m/d. Explain the direction using clarifier hydraulic interface, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 低溫情境~Cold-weather scenario
units.mechanism: 低溫改變菌體速率，應以實驗辨識速率及污泥保留是否足夠。~Low temperature changes biological rates; test kinetics and biomass retention together.
units.model: 原創教學假設：r20=0.08 d⁻¹；θ=1.07；T=15 °C。模型 rT=r20 θ^(T-20)，代入得到 0.057038894 d⁻¹。適用邊界：假設係數且限狹窄溫度區間，不能跨菌群或熱失活區外插。~Original teaching assumptions: r20=0.08 d⁻¹; θ=1.07; T=15 °C. Model rT=r20 θ^(T-20) gives 0.057038894 d⁻¹. Applicability: Assumed coefficient in a narrow temperature range; do not extrapolate across populations or thermal inactivation.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「低溫情境」的觀測點。由不同溫度的批次資料擬合後，以未參與擬合的資料檢驗。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for cold-weather scenario. Fit batch data across temperatures and validate on held-out observations. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 套用暖季速率會低估冷季反應時間。診斷與介入：改用符合溫度區間的實驗資料，重跑低溫情境。~Warm-season rates understate cold-season reaction time. Diagnostic response: Use observations appropriate to the temperature range and replay cold conditions.
units.misconception: 水溫變化不影響生物反應。~Water temperature does not affect biological reaction.
units.practice: 只改變 T:15→18 °C，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.057038894 變為 0.069875098 d⁻¹。用「低溫情境」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only T:15→18 °C, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.057038894 to 0.069875098 d⁻¹. Explain the direction using cold-weather scenario, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 能耗與出水共同驗證~Joint energy and effluent verification
units.mechanism: 比較節能方案時同時檢查氨氮、總氮與固體，避免把降低處理程度當節能。~Compare ammonium, total nitrogen and solids alongside energy so reduced treatment is not mistaken for efficiency.
units.model: 原創教學假設：電力 E=960 kWh/d；處理量 Q=3000 m³/d。模型 SEC=E/Q，代入得到 0.32 kWh/m³。適用邊界：同一系統邊界與同一日；需同時滿足出流水品質。~Original teaching assumptions: Electricity E=960 kWh/d; flow Q=3000 m³/d. Model SEC=E/Q gives 0.32 kWh/m³. Applicability: Use identical system boundaries and days; effluent quality must also be satisfied.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「能耗與出水共同驗證」的觀測點。同步讀取電表、流量計與水質趨勢。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for joint energy and effluent verification. Synchronize electricity, flow and water-quality trends. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 停曝氣節電卻導致出水惡化屬失敗方案。診斷與介入：配對相同流量與出水品質再比較能耗，列出附屬設備。~Saving power by stopping aeration while degrading effluent is failure. Diagnostic response: Compare energy at matched flow/quality and list auxiliary equipment.
units.misconception: 電表最低的方案必定最佳。~The lowest-meter-reading option is always best.
units.practice: 只改變 E:960→840 kWh/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.32 變為 0.28 kWh/m³。用「能耗與出水共同驗證」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only E:960→840 kWh/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.32 to 0.28 kWh/m³. Explain the direction using joint energy and effluent verification, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.
